# Puppeteer AI

> HIPAA-compliant AI voice agents that automate healthcare workflows including patient intake, appointment scheduling, triage, and engagement.

Puppeteer AI provides conversational AI solutions specifically designed for healthcare organizations. The platform enables automation across the entire patient journey through voice, SMS, and chat interfaces while maintaining strict HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA-compliant
- AI voice agents
- Healthcare automation
- Patient intake
- Appointment scheduling
- Triage automation
- Patient engagement
- EHR integration
- Virtual health assistant
- 24/7 availability
- Clinical workflows
- Patient reactivation
- SMS communication
- Voice-based interactions
- Healthcare AI

- [AI Digital Patient Intake Forms | Puppeteer AI](https://puppeteerai.com/use-cases/intake): HIPAA-compliant automated patient intake via voice, SMS, or chat
- [AI Triage for Healthcare Clinics | Puppeteer AI](https://puppeteerai.com/use-cases/triaging): Automated patient triage routing based on symptoms and urgency

- [Patient Reactivation](https://puppeteerai.com/use-cases/patient-reactivation): AI-powered patient reactivation and dormant patient recovery automation
